paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 98:9. R' Chunya and R' Yirmeyah reported in his name.[^1]

notes.text: All three personal titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. Chunya and Yirmeyah report in the contextual heading subject’s name; no actual teaching is supplied, so the old cited-teachings bracket is not imported. 98:9 is conventional from פצ״ח-ט without independently checked modern edition mapping or further Chunya identification.
